subject: SKU tiling + co-sell eligibility — proposal for marketplace surface
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: SKU tiling + co-sell eligibility — proposal for marketplace surface

Team,

I pulled together an initial "tiling" approach for how we surface Redwood offers across AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces and which bundles should be eligible for co-sell. High level:

- Surface a minimal entry SKU (pay-as-you-go) per cloud for quick onboarding.
- Offer two tiered reserved SKUs (monthly, annual) mapped to our Dedicated and Private usage profiles.
- Region gating: US (all clouds) first wave, EU next wave (compliance/sovereignty checks), APAC as third wave.
- Co-sell eligibility: require minimum committed ARR and supported entitlements per cloud (see draft thresholds).

Attached: sku-tiling-proposal.xlsx (draft matrix with mapping and suggested region buckets).

Asks: quick read-through and call to align cloud-specific constraints (Azure listing requirements, GCP billing SKU shapes). Would like a short decisions email by end of week so we can start legal/ops packaging.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sku-tiling-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU tiling + co-sell eligibility — proposal for marketplace surface

Rafael — thanks for the clear start. Quick notes inline and an attached working tab with cloud constraints.

- Azure: their marketplace requires per-VMSKU level mapping for reserved offers if we want co-sell. That means our "reserved monthly" SKU will need to map to a small set of VM families (N-series / ND variants). Suggest we maintain two reserved SKUs but create an internal mapping table to VM families rather than trying a single SKU across all instance families.
- GCP: revenue recognition on marketplace is trickier for resellers. For co-sell eligibility we need to make sure our listing calls out direct purchase path + reseller path — otherwise partner registration breaks.
- Regions: Agree on US -> EU -> APAC wave, but flag EEA sales/regulatory review for Private deployments (data residency).

Attachment: sku-tiling-proposal.xlsx (updated, tab: cloud-constraints).

I can join a partner ops call tomorrow to walk through the mapping.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Cloud GTM, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sku-tiling-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet, updated)]

Subject: Re: SKU tiling + co-sell eligibility — proposal for marketplace surface

Hi Rafael / Karthik —

Appreciate the clear matrix. AcmeCloud Marketplace partner ops reviewed the draft and we are generally aligned on the approach. A couple of asks from our side before we finalize co-sell eligibility:

1) Region specifics: for co-sell handoffs we need explicit region endpoints listed for each SKU (e.g., us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1). Can you include the specific endpoints per cloud so our ops team can pre-create entitlement mappings?
2) Minimum entitlements: confirm whether Private deployment SKUs will include audit-log export and KMS integration by default; our compliance customers require that for co-sell with our enterprise sellers.
3) Commercial path: for Azure we need a reseller-approved quote flow (not just marketplace purchase) to qualify for co-sell incentives.

We can jump on a 30-min sync tomorrow 11am ET to finalize. Sending this to marketplace-ops to prep.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Partner Programs Manager — AcmeCloud Marketplace
AcmeCloud Inc.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU tiling + co-sell eligibility — proposal for marketplace surface

Thanks everyone — good alignment and useful asks from AcmeCloud. Summarizing decisions and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Decisions:
- SKUs: three customer-facing SKUs per cloud (Entry PAYG, Reserved-Monthly, Reserved-Annual). Internally we will maintain a VM/instance-family mapping table (Azure/GCP) for Reserved SKUs.
- Regions: Wave 1 = us-east-1, us-west-2 (AWS); eastus2, westeurope (Azure); us-central1, europe-west1 (GCP). Wave 2 = full EU (after legal signoff).
- Co-sell eligibility: Reserved-Annual and Reserved-Monthly qualify when an opportunity meets the ARR threshold (see HubSpot note). Entry PAYG is not eligible for co-sell.
- Private deployment SKU: includes audit-log export and KMS integration by default for co-sell-eligible listings.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: finalize instance-family mapping spreadsheet and add explicit region endpoints for each cloud (due: 2026-10-25). [Attachment: final-sku-matrix.csv will include mapping].
- Marissa: start SKU packaging ticket with Legal/Procurement (DocuSign flow & reseller quote path) and open HubSpot opp (HUB-78923) for AcmeCloud co-sell (due: 2026-10-27).
- Sean: schedule partner ops intake with AcmeCloud and Azure marketplace team; include marketplace-ops@azurepartners.com (meeting scheduled: 2026-10-22 11am ET).
- Rafael: publish final matrix to Drive and notify engineering/product for listing builds.

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSKU-TILING, HubSpot opp: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/78923

Attachments: final-sku-matrix.csv, action-items.docx

I'll run the 11am ET sync with AcmeCloud and Azure ops and circulate meeting notes. If there are major objections today let me know — otherwise we'll proceed on the timeline above.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
